description: This PHP source file defines the ModuleBuilderViewWizard class, which manages the interface and logic for creating and editing module views within the SuiteCRM module builder. It handles different modules and view types like layouts, subpanels, search, dashlets, and popups, generating corresponding buttons and navigation breadcrumbs. It extends the SugarView class and interacts with other components such as AjaxCompose, StudioBrowser, and translation functions.
